decided_by: DRE-6414's own example, not a CEO decision — changing either number is an ordinary edit to this file
why: An epic has crossed when it is running more than `ratio` times the size the CEO approved AND at least `minimum_added` more cards than that: more than double, and at least ten more. DRE-4721 was approved at 10 and ran 50; DRE-5577 at 17 and ran 41. Both cross; an epic approved at 10 running 20, or at 4 running 9, does not. scripts/epic_growth.py is the one reader.
